notes: XPath is supported as a typed value, Locator.xpath(expression), rather than an xpath= or // string prefix: element nodes in document order, relative to each match when chained, and InvalidInput at once for a malformed or non-node-set expression. text=, >> and custom selector engines are excluded for 1.0. :has-text() and the other Playwright pseudo-classes have no exclusion decision; filter({ hasText }) and getByText cover their text matching. The combined gap stays missing until every remaining form is built or excluded.
